english.title: Publish assertion in breach of derogatory assertion order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[were the proprietor of a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..), published in Great Britain and available to the public, in which an assertion, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSERTION..), was published]_
(B)_[were the editor of a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..), published in Great Britain and available to the public, in which an assertion, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSERTION..), was published]_
(C)_[were the publisher of a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..), published in Great Britain and available to the public, in which an assertion, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSERTION..), was published]_
(D)_[published an assertion, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSERTION..),]_
(E)_[were a body corporate engaged in providing a service in which a relevant programme for reception in Great Britain, namely **(..SPECIFY PROGRAMME..), was included, that programme including an assertion, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSERTION..),]_
(F)_[were a person having functions corresponding to those of an editor of a newspaper in relation to a relevant programme for reception in Great Britain, namely **(..SPECIFY PROGRAMME..), which included an assertion, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSERTION..),]_

while

(G)_[a derogatory]_
(H)_[an interim derogatory]_

assertion order had effect in relation to that assertion
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40 of the Sentencing Act 2020.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the proprietor / editor / publisher of a newspaper / periodical published in Great Britain and available to the public in which an assertion was published
person publishing an assertion OR
body corporate engaged in providing service in which a relevant programme for reception in GB was included and programme included assertion OR
person having functions corresponding to those of editor of newspaper in relation to a relevant programme for reception in GB which included an assertion
whilst (interim) derogatory assertion order had effect

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 40(3) provides a defence where the person was not aware of the (interim) derogatory assertion order or the fact that the programme or publication included the assertion in question.
(ii) For corporate liability see further section 40(4).
